# DESeq2 Analyss
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Build Sample Metadata 
metadata <- data.frame(
  sample    = paste0("Sample_", sprintf("%02d", 1:18)),
  cell_line = factor(c(rep("1868", 6),
                       rep("2586", 6),
                       rep("1478", 6))),
  treatment = factor(c("Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive",
                       "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine",
                       "Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive",
                       "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine",
                       "Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive", "Treatment_Naive",
                       "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine",     "Gemcitabine"),
                     levels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Gemcitabine")),
  replicate = factor(c(1,2,3, 1,2,3,
                       1,2,3, 1,2,3,
                       1,2,3, 1,2,3)),
  replicate_id = factor(c(rep("1868", 3),
                          rep("1868_Gem", 3),
                          rep("2586_TN", 3),
                          rep("2586_Gem", 3),
                          rep("1478_TN", 3),
                          rep("1478_Gem", 3))),
  row.names = paste0("Sample_", sprintf("%02d", 1:18))
)

# Verify metadata looks correct
print(metadata)

#write.csv(metadata, "CAFs_gemcitabine_metadata.csv")

# ── 6. Verify matrix and metadata match ──────────────────────
all(colnames(count_matrix) == rownames(metadata))  # must be TRUE

# ── 7. Build DESeqDataSet ─────────────────────────────────────
# Design: test treatment effect accounting for cell line
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(count_matrix),   # round because of fractional multimappers
  colData   = metadata,
  design    = ~ cell_line + treatment
)

vst <- assay(vst(dds))
rv <- rowVars(vst)
select <- order(rv, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(dds)))]
pca <- pca(vst[select,], metadata = colData(dds))
biplot(pca,
       showLoadings = F,
       boxedLoadingsNames = T,
       colby = 'treatment',
       shape = 'cell_line',
       labSize = 0, pointSize = 5, 
       legendPosition = 'right',
       legendLabSize = 7, legendIconSize = 4, legendTitleSize = 10)

biplot(pca,
       showLoadings = F,
       boxedLoadingsNames = T,
       colby = 'cell_line',
       shape = 'replicate',
       labSize = 0, pointSize = 5,
       legendPosition = 'right',
       legendLabSize = 7, legendIconSize = 4, legendTitleSize = 10)

#Here we collpase the technical replicates of each sample so we can look at the average values of each. 
dds_full <- dds
dds <- collapseReplicates(dds, dds$replicate_id)
vst_full <- assay(vst(dds_full))
vst <- assay(vst(dds))
rv <- rowVars(vst)
rv_full <- rowVars(vst_full)
select <- order(rv, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(dds)))]
select_full <- order(rv_full, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(dds)))]
pca <- pca(vst[select,], metadata = colData(dds))
biplot(pca,
       showLoadings = F,
       boxedLoadingsNames = T,
       colby = 'cell_line',
       shape = 'treatment',
       labSize = 0, pointSize = 5, 
       legendPosition = 'right',
       legendLabSize = 7, legendIconSize = 4, legendTitleSize = 10)

pca <- pca(vst_full[select_full,], metadata = colData(dds_full))
biplot(pca,
       showLoadings = F,
       boxedLoadingsNames = T,
       colby = 'cell_line',
       shape = 'treatment',
       labSize = 0, pointSize = 5, 
       legendPosition = 'right',
       legendLabSize = 7, legendIconSize = 4, legendTitleSize = 10)

map_genes <- function(genes) {
  gm <- gene_info[gene_info$gene_name %in% genes, c("Geneid", "gene_name")]
  gm <- gm[!duplicated(gm$gene_name), ]
  cat("Found:", gm$gene_name, "\n")
  cat("Missing:", setdiff(genes, gm$gene_name), "\n")
  gm
}
gene_map_neural <- map_genes(neural)
wnt_map <- map_genes(wnt)
gene_map_mycaf <- map_genes(myCAF_genes)
icaf_map <- map_genes(iCAF_genes)
all_map <- map_genes(all)

neural_matrix   <- vst[gene_map_neural$Geneid, ]
rownames(neural_matrix) <- gene_map_neural$gene_name
wnt_matrix <- vst[wnt_map$Geneid, ]

rownames(mycaf_matrix) <- gene_map_mycaf$gene_name

all_matrix <- vst[all_map$Geneid, ]

df <- as.data.frame(colData(dds))
ann_df <- df[, c("cell_line", "treatment")]
pheatmap(neural_matrix, scale = 'row', cluster_rows=FALSE, show_rownames=TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,

         cluster_cols=FALSE, trace = "none", annotation_col=ann_df, border_color = "black", cellwidth = 10, cellheight = 10, col = colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")) )(15))
pheatmap(neural_matrix, scale = 'row', cluster_rows=FALSE, show_rownames=TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,

pheatmap(wnt_matrix[, tn_samples], scale = 'row', cluster_rows=TRUE

pheatmap(mycaf_matrix[, tn_samples], scale = 'row', cluster_rows=TRUE, show_rownames=TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,

# Remove rows with zero or NA variance
icaf_matrix_filtered <- icaf_matrix[, tn_samples]

row_vars <- apply(icaf_matrix_filtered, 1, var)
icaf_matrix_filtered <- icaf_matrix_filtered[!is.na(row_vars) & row_vars > 0, ]

# Confirm no NAs remain after scaling
scaled_check <- t(scale(t(icaf_matrix_filtered)))
sum(is.na(scaled_check))  # Should be 0
pheatmap(icaf_matrix_filtered[, tn_samples], scale = 'row', cluster_rows=TRUE
         , show_rownames=TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,

#Bar plot versions
library(plyr)
plot_gene_bar <- function(gene_symbol, vst_full, metadata_full) {
  
  # Get Ensembl ID for this gene
  gene_id <- gene_info$Geneid[
    which(!is.na(gene_info$gene_name) & gene_info$gene_name == gene_symbol)
  ][1]
  
  if (is.na(gene_id)) {
    message("Gene not found: ", gene_symbol)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (!(gene_id %in% rownames(vst_full))) {
    message("Gene ID found in gene_info but not in vst_full: ", gene_id)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Build replicate-level data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    expression = as.numeric(vst_full[gene_id, ]),
    sample     = colnames(vst_full)
  ) %>%
    left_join(metadata_full, by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(expression_scaled = expression)
  
  # Make sure treatment order is correct
  df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment,
                         levels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Gemcitabine"))
  
  # Summarize mean and SEM
  summary_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_line, treatment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_expression = mean(expression_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_expression   = sd(expression_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
      n               = dplyr::n(),
      sem_expression  = sd_expression / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  # Plot
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cell_line, y = mean_expression, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.65,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_expression - sem_expression,
          ymax = mean_expression + sem_expression),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df,
      aes(x = cell_line, y = expression_scaled, fill = treatment),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.05,
        dodge.width = 0.75
      ),
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.8,
      color = "black",
      shape = 21,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Treatment_Naive" = "#F4C0D1",
                 "Gemcitabine"     = "#C2185B"),
      labels = c("Treatment_Naive" = "TREATMENT NAIVE",
                 "Gemcitabine"     = "POST CHEMOTHERAPY")
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(italic(.(gene_symbol))),
      y     = "Expression Level (z-score)",
      x     = NULL,
      fill  = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold.italic",
                                        hjust = 0.5,
                                        size = 13),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.border       = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}


#Log normalize data 
# Make numeric count matrix
counts_mat <- as.matrix(round(count_matrix))
storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"

# Library size per sample
lib_size <- colSums(counts_mat)

# Seurat-like LogNormalize: log1p(counts per 10,000)
lognorm_10k <- log1p(t(t(counts_mat) / lib_size * 10000))

# Check dimensions and values
dim(lognorm_10k)
range(lognorm_10k, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(lognorm_10k)


#now make a new function to add stats to the bar 
plot_gene_bar_lognorm_stats <- function(gene_symbol, expr_mat, metadata_full,
                                        test = "t.test") {
  
  # Get Ensembl ID for this gene
  gene_id <- gene_info$Geneid[
    which(!is.na(gene_info$gene_name) & gene_info$gene_name == gene_symbol)
  ][1]
  
  if (is.na(gene_id)) {
    message("Gene not found: ", gene_symbol)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (!(gene_id %in% rownames(expr_mat))) {
    message("Gene ID found in gene_info but not in expression matrix: ", gene_id)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Build replicate-level data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    expression = as.numeric(expr_mat[gene_id, ]),
    sample     = colnames(expr_mat)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metadata_full, by = "sample")
  
  df$treatment <- factor(df$treatment,
                         levels = c("Treatment_Naive", "Gemcitabine"))
  
  df$cell_line <- factor(df$cell_line,
                         levels = c("1868", "2586", "1478"))
  
  # Summarize mean and SEM for bars
  summary_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_line, treatment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_expression   = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      n               = dplyr::n(),
      sem_expression  = sd_expression / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Statistical test within each cell line
  if (test == "t.test") {
    stat_df <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(cell_line) %>%
      rstatix::t_test(expression ~ treatment) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  } else if (test == "wilcox.test") {
    stat_df <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(cell_line) %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(expression ~ treatment) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  } else {
    stop("test must be either 't.test' or 'wilcox.test'")
  }
  
  # Add bracket positions
  max_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_line) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      ymax = max(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  stat_df <- stat_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(max_df, by = "cell_line") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cell_line_num = as.numeric(factor(cell_line, levels = c("1868", "2586", "1478"))),
      xmin = cell_line_num - 0.2,
      xmax = cell_line_num + 0.2,
      y.position = ymax + 0.25,
      p_label = dplyr::case_when(
        p <= 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p <= 0.001  ~ "***",
        p <= 0.01   ~ "**",
        p <= 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE        ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  
  # Plot
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cell_line, y = mean_expression, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.65,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_expression - sem_expression,
          ymax = mean_expression + sem_expression),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df,
      aes(x = cell_line, y = expression, fill = treatment),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.05,
        dodge.width = 0.75
      ),
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.85,
      color = "black",
      shape = 21,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "xmin",
      xmax = "xmax",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.35,
      size = 4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Treatment_Naive" = "#F4C0D1",
                 "Gemcitabine"     = "#C2185B"),
      labels = c("Treatment_Naive" = "TREATMENT NAIVE",
                 "Gemcitabine"     = "POST CHEMOTHERAPY")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(italic(.(gene_symbol))),
      y     = "Log-normalized expression",
      x     = NULL,
      fill  = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold.italic",
                                        hjust = 0.5,
                                        size = 13),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.border       = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

plot_gene_bar("SEMA3A", lognorm_10k, metadata) 
plot_gene_bar_lognorm_stats("SEMA3A", lognorm_10k, metadata)

plot_gene_bar("NRP1", lognorm_10k, metadata)
plot_gene_bar_lognorm_stats("NRP1", lognorm_10k, metadata)
```
